summary: This bill establishes a grant program to fund a national faith-based resource center that will provide education, training, and technical assistance to faith communities and victim service providers to improve responses to domestic violence, dating violence, sexual assault, and stalking, and also directs the Attorney General to develop model state legislative language to address religious divorce denial.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a grant program for a national faith-based resource center focused on domestic violence, dating violence, sexual assault, and stalking. It aims to improve the response of various stakeholders, including law enforcement, prosecutors, and courts, to victims with faith, and to enhance the capacity of faith communities to prevent and respond to these crimes. This directly relates to strengthening the justice system's response to specific crimes and supporting victims, aligning with stricter justice and stronger policing in the context of these offenses.
